cards.prose: At the birth in Luke, a *multitude of the heavenly host* is praising Elohim (God) over the shepherds' field. Revelation has heaven full of voices again: *a great voice of much people in heaven*, saying *Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power* to Elohim (God). Both times the sky gives the glory to Elohim (God), and the second time it is because *true and righteous are his judgments* (Revelation 19:2).
cards.member_phrase: I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia
cards.member_sentence: A great voice of much people in heaven gives salvation, glory, honour and power to Elohim (God), as the host did at the birth.
